title: Terrabounds Faction Claims
description: This mod introduces a client and server side function that allows for chunk claiming with siege mechanics.
body:
⚔️ Terrabounds Claim & Siege System
Welcome to an immersion-first, team-based land management mod built for competitive, high-stakes survival.

Instead of treating player claims as completely untouchable magical bubbles, the Terrabounds Claim System introduces dynamic PVP siege mechanics. Establish your realm, secure your borders, and prepare to defend your strongholds from enemy factions equipped to tear them down.

⚠️ Note: This is my very first mod! It is currently a work in progress, and mechanics (especially the siege systems) are being actively developed and balanced.

👑 Kingdom Management
Everything starts with your faction. Rather than managing loose individual chunks, you work as a collective to build a empire from the ground up.

Using the simple chat interface, you can manage your team, coordinate with neighbors, and set local laws with ease:

/kingdom create <name> – Form your kingdom and lay claim to your first territory.

Factions & Diplomacy: Easily manage your roster, invite trusted members, declare allies, and dictate rules within your borders.

💣 Dynamic Siege Mechanics
No fortress is completely safe. If you want an enemy's land, you have to fight for it. Attackers can bypass claim protections and wage full-scale war using a suite of custom tactical items:

🚩 The Siege Activator
To initiate a raid, attackers must craft a Siege Activator and deploy it on a banner placed just outside the enemy kingdom's chunk boundaries. Once activated, the war begins, and the claim's total protection drops.

🧨 The Detonator
Walls are meant to be breached. During an active siege, raiding players can utilize the custom Detonator item to trigger localized explosions. Use them tactically to blow holes in enemy defenses, shatter stone barriers, and breach the base.

🗝️ The Lockpick
Reaching the vault isn't the end of the raid. Defending players can lock down their storage, but skilled intruders can utilize the Lockpick item to bypass locked chests, crack open enemy vaults, and plunder the valuables inside.
